attributes.overview_copy: Project Rebuild is a Base-based unlimited-mint NFT ebook powered by FAMM and may become the community-owned BooksOnChain platform if successful.
attributes.referral_code_identity_copy: Each NFT's mint number is its permanent referral code, shareable as either a complete link or the mint number.
attributes.referral_commission_copy: A successful mint using a referral code immediately pays the referrer a $5 commission.
attributes.referral_ticket_copy: Each successful code-used mint gives the referrer one Small Block ticket and one Big Block ticket.
attributes.future_token_copy: Buyers, affiliates, and tippers are described as recipients of a future BooksOnChain governance token.
attributes.code_location_copy: The referral code appears in on-chain NFT metadata, on the post-mint dashboard, and optionally in the confirmation email.
attributes.small_block_prize_copy: Five $500 prizes are drawn about every 500 sales, counting mints and secondary sales.
attributes.big_block_prize_copy: Five $10,000 prizes are drawn about every 50,000 sales, counting mints and secondary sales.
attributes.pool_funding_copy: Every mint and secondary sale funds the prize pools indefinitely.
attributes.winner_selection_copy: Chainlink VRF selects winners on-chain with results verifiable on Basescan.
attributes.ticket_expiration_copy: Tickets apply to the current corresponding block, expire after its draw, and later referrals earn tickets for subsequent blocks.
attributes.reward_delivery_copy: Commissions transfer automatically to the wallet, while prize wins appear on the Winners page and are claimable with one click.
attributes.badge_copy: On-chain badges are awarded at referral milestones and currently serve cosmetic and leaderboard purposes, with possible future utilities.
attributes.fiat_payment_copy: Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay without requiring buyers to already hold crypto or have a wallet.
attributes.wallet_requirement_copy: A wallet is required when a participant wants commission payments or intends to trade the NFT.
attributes.network_copy: The product uses Base, described as a fast, inexpensive, Coinbase-backed Ethereum L2.
attributes.price_and_fee_copy: Minting costs exactly $15, and secondary sales carry a clearly displayed flat $10 royalty.
attributes.resale_copy: A purchaser receives the book, original mint-number referral code, and earned badges; expired tickets remain expired.
attributes.referral_sharing_copy: The dashboard lets holders copy either the complete referral link or only their mint number.
attributes.anti_scam_copy: The model is single-level, has unlimited supply, exposes verified source code on Basescan, and gives the founder $4 from every mint and secondary sale.
attributes.support_copy: Until Discord launches after the project gains traction, support is available through X direct messages and email.

attributes.subtitle: The first ebook launch that pays readers to spread it.
overview_copy: Project Rebuild serves as the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — the first system that allows indie creators to sell NFT ebooks with unlimited minting and reward readers with real commissions + prize tickets for sharing them.
It is launching on Base with my own raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal,".
It is also my public mission to rebuild my family's life after a seed-phrase wipeout caused us to lose millions.
If our FAMM proves itself here, Project Rebuild will become BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform for every creator.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. Big Block: 5 × $10,000 awarded every 50,000 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.

vision_copy: Project Rebuild begins with one book, but that is only the start.
We imagine a world where ebooks succeed solely on merit, free from gatekeepers and Amazon algorithms that drown out indie voices.
In that world, creators (unknown or established) rise because their work connects with people, not because they game a platform, have the connections, or purchase enough ads.
Fans are paid for the word-of-mouth marketing they have always provided for free, while any hustler can jump in and earn after spotting a gem worth spreading.
Our goal is a self-sustaining model that benefits everyone.
Artists receive their fair share, fans & affiliates develop real income, and communities build direct bonds — turning one underdog's recovery into a decentralized revolution for all creators.
All without hype, driven only by aligned incentives.

overview_copy: Project Rebuild serves as the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — the first system that allows indie creators to sell NFT ebooks with unlimited minting and reward readers with real commissions + prize tickets for sharing them.
It is launching on Base with my own raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal,".
It is also my public mission to rebuild my family's life after a seed-phrase wipeout caused us to lose millions.
If our FAMM proves itself here, Project Rebuild will become BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform for every creator.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy the ebook NFT for $15. The mint number received becomes the buyer's referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share the mint number or referral link. Each completed referral earns an immediate, unlimited $5 commission and one ticket for the recurring $500 drawing.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every completed referral automatically adds one on-chain ticket for the active $500 drawing to the holder's NFT and dashboard. More referrals mean more chances to win.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draw
process_items.copy: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through provably fair Chainlink VRF selection.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically, while a $500 winner is notified on the Winners page, dashboard, and by email when available and collects the prize through a conditional claim button shown only when the prize is eligible to be claimed.

key_feature_items.label: Gamification

vision_copy: Project Rebuild begins with one book, but that is only the start.
We imagine a world where ebooks succeed solely on merit, free from gatekeepers and Amazon algorithms that drown out indie voices.
In that world, creators (unknown or established) rise because their work connects with people, not because they game a platform, have the connections, or purchase enough ads.
Fans are paid for the word-of-mouth marketing they have always provided for free, while any hustler can jump in and earn after spotting a gem worth spreading.
Our goal is a self-sustaining model that benefits everyone.
Artists receive their fair share, fans & affiliates develop real income, and communities build direct bonds — turning one underdog's recovery into a decentralized revolution for all creators.
All without hype, driven only by aligned incentives.
